groups.name: Annotation model and rendering
groups.rationale: Defines the data structures and pure functions that turn text selections into queued annotations and render the popup UI.

groups.name: Conversation panel rendering and state
groups.rationale: Defines the right-side panel UI as pure functions: delivered conversation entries, queued annotation pills, comment box, and send buttons.

groups.name: Session API client
groups.rationale: Centralizes all HTTP calls to the backend: fetching session data, persisting reviewed flags, and sending feedback with prompts.

groups.name: Diff view mounting and update
groups.rationale: Mounts the rendered diff groups into the DOM and handles checkbox interactions for reviewing; extracted to a mountable component so the main orchestrator can wire it to SSE updates.

groups.name: Annotation popup mounting and interaction
groups.rationale: Wires text selection events to the popup UI, splits selections along file blocks, and queues annotations via the callback.

groups.name: Conversation panel mounting and interaction
groups.rationale: Mounts the panel into the DOM, manages the browser's pending queue, wires pill removal and send buttons to the API, and redraws after each state change.

groups.name: Main entry point and orchestration
groups.rationale: Wires all three mounted components together, fetches the initial session, and hooks SSE updates to refresh the diff and panel when a re-group arrives.

groups.name: Styles for annotation and panel UI
groups.rationale: Adds CSS for the popup, pills, general comment box, send buttons, and delivered conversation entries to match the existing editor aesthetic.

groups.name: Build entry point update
groups.rationale: Redirects the build to the new nested entry point in `src/browser/dom/main.ts` after the old file was moved.

groups.name: TypeScript configuration
groups.rationale: Moves the DOM exclusion from the root tsconfig to cover the whole `src/browser/dom/` folder, since that directory now contains all DOM-touching modules and is checked by a separate browser config.

groups.name: Task tracking
groups.rationale: Marks Task 8 (browser annotation and conversation panel) as complete in both plan and todo files.

groups.name: Tests
groups.rationale: The checks this change ships, gathered to be read or skipped together.
